propositions: Complexity and file-size debt: 87 source modules exceed documented 500-LOC target; multiple files near or at 800 LOC including runner.py, _config_schema.py, init.py, _ref_lock.py, and signing.py; 206 functions exceed complexity 15.

Type precision is broad but shallow: mypy passes all source in normal mode but --disallow-untyped-defs finds 687 errors; only rebar.graph.* and rebar.grounding.* enforce strictness; missing-imports globally ignored rather than narrowed at boundaries.
Architectural enforcement is selective: high-risk seams have bespoke checks but no systemic repository-wide package dependency DAG contract; relies on review rather than automated controls.

Documentation and quickstart examples contain contradictions and stale information: assignee examples omit required email/accountId, routing links are inconsistent, environment/dependency descriptions do not match current topology, and mutation-testing dates are stale without scheduled gating.

CI test-environment flakiness: Python 3.11 xdist worker repeatably crashes after ~11.4k tests in test_opcert_service_app.py with 'node down: Not properly terminated,' causing spurious Verified-1 and 8–24 minute rerun latency.
